title: Assemble raw trace and coefficient root-power compatibility
statement: Use [def-pur-affine-diagonal-integration-constructions] in the finite setting [def-pur-conventions]. Let f:U→B be compactifiable quasi-compact with a specified rank-d affine tower presentation, and B finite type over k. For r≤r' annihilating A, supply a normalized root-power map q on U and a line comparison e with its pure-generator formula. Then the ordered shifted tensor comparison induced by e, followed by the presented exceptional transpose at r, equals the presented exceptional transpose at r'. The existence of q,e and the corresponding compact-support integration equation are not part of this statement.

source.place: Agreement on the model: ordered projective-line-normalized integration; annihilator independence clause of the orientation refinement

proof.text: Apply the exponent clause of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback] on B to obtain a root-power map qB and the line isomorphism eB, with their kernel and pure-generator equations. Invertibility of the root exponent on B follows from [def-pur-conventions].

Apply [lem-pur-affine-diagonal-power-coefficient] to obtain comparison of the two coefficient prefixes and [lem-pur-affine-diagonal-raw-transpose-power] for the raw ordered trace transposes. In the explicit formula [def-pur-affine-diagonal-integration-constructions], reassociate, substitute the coefficient equation, combine the two pullback maps by functoriality, substitute the raw transpose equation and append the unchanged dualizing base-change mate. The proved private categorical transport lemma performs exactly this calculation.

theorem affineDiagonalTranspose_powerCompatible (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {U B : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : U ⟶ B) [HasCompactification f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB]
    (r r' : ℕ) (hrr : r ≤ r')
    (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : P.Coefficient) = 0)
    (hA' : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1) : ℕ) : P.Coefficient) = 0)
    (c : U ≅ affineTraceTower B d) (hc : c.hom ≫ affineTraceProjection B d = f)
    (q : U.rootsOfUnitySheaf (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)) ⟶
      U.rootsOfUnitySheaf (P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)))
    (e : Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine U (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)) P.Coefficient hA' ≅
      Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine U (P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) P.Coefficient hA)
    (hq : q ≫ kernel.ι ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) • 𝟙 U.gmSheaf) =
      (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1) / P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) •
        kernel.ι ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)) • 𝟙 U.gmSheaf))
    (he : ∀ (V : U.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : P.Coefficient)
      (z : (U.rootsOfUnitySheaf (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1))).obj.obj V),
      e.hom.hom.app V (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator P.Coefficient
        (P.coefficients.l ^ (r' + 1)) U hA' V a z) =
      Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator P.Coefficient
        (P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) U hA V a (q.hom.app V z)) :
    (P.affineDiagonalPowerComparison U r r' hA hA' e d).hom ≫
      P.affineDiagonalPresentedTranspose d f aB r hA c hc =
        P.affineDiagonalPresentedTranspose d f aB r' hA' c hc
